summary: Long Mountain steel tower in Cumberland County, built 1922; moved in 1952 and renamed Bandana. Where the moved tower stands is not given.

facts.status_note: Moved in 1952 and renamed Bandana; the original Long Mountain site is a former lookout site

events.note: Steel tower built 1922 per the register; the road to the site was finished in October 1922
Henry C. Sheaffer served as observer
Towerman reported watching three mountain fires over a recent weekend (May 1933 item)
Moved and renamed Bandana; the sources read do not give the new location
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on September 16, 2008

evidence.quote: This steel Blaw-Knox tower was built in 1922.
It was moved in 1952 and renamed Bandana.

evidence.supports: Road to the new tower site finished October 1922
evidence.quote: to the site of the new fire tower to be erected on Long mountain is completed.

notes_for_editor: The brief's name 'L' is a parse error of the page heading 'L ONG MOUNTAIN'. The agency field holds a site note. The register says the tower was moved and renamed Bandana, but no source read gives where Bandana stands or whether it survives; a second search found nothing. The brief's coordinates are unconfirmed because the register lists none.
